Description: The core workbench. Visual dataset/column picker with dual list boxes, WHERE-condition filter builder, DISTINCT toggle, and live SQL / SAS / Python code preview. Routes to either static JSON files or a SAS stored-process API. Column metadata ''i'' icons open logical name, long description and load frequency from column_metadata.csv.
Column distribution explorer. Profiles any selected column and renders its value distribution, with the shared DMW config/session/filter infrastructure.

Unsupervised clustering of claims by billing behaviour. D3 scatter plot with convex-hull cluster boundaries, colour-coded risk tiers, and a linked observations grid with bi-directional scatter-to-row highlighting.

Pairwise Pearson correlation heatmap with a diverging colour scale, three selectable schemes, a magnitude filter, adjustable cell size, and a sortable correlation-pairs table. Serves as the structural template for the whole report family.
Grouped box-and-whisker plots showing median, IQR, whiskers and outlier points across a grouping column. Provides the 1.5x IQR fence used elsewhere for outlier detection.
Overlapping semi-transparent histograms with KDE curves, comparing the value distribution of several groups on one axis.
Hexagonal density binning for high-volume scatter data, using a sequential colour scale to reveal concentration where individual points would overplot.

Multi-series time-series line graph with a linked AG Grid table. Running-minimum ''best so far'' step line, mean/median/percentile reference lines, 1.5x IQR outlier fences, and bidirectional chart-to-grid selection.

Sentiment and topic analysis of public comments on proposed CMS rules. Category x sentiment heatmap, hand-written spiral word cloud, and per-comment summaries. Offline lexicon scoring with negation handling; D3 fully inlined for air-gapped use.

PRIOR AUTHORIZATION solution. Monitors the CR 14443 ADR response exchange between CMS PCG FHIR and the MAC. Six-stage case pipeline, 7-day decision-window SLA table with amber/red tinting, failed/dead-letter queue, and decision-mix analytics. Derived from 500 June 2026 API transactions.

Standard-library-only Python downloader for public comments from regulations.gov. Filters by agency, date range and keyword; paginates with rate limiting; outputs JSON or CSV ready for the NLP Sentiment Dashboard.

Browser SQL client with editor, results grid, telemetry and CSV/JSON export. Three execution modes: a built-in SQL engine for offline use, a live SAS Stored Process bridge, and a generic REST endpoint. Zero third-party JavaScript dependencies.

Server half of SQL Studio. A streaming SAS stored process that validates the statement (read-only guard), connects to SQL Server via SAS/ACCESS OLEDB, caps rows, and returns JSON. Registered in SMC; no software installation required.

Foundation for moving report state out of the browser. Authenticates via a SAS stored process, then reads and writes a data-driven dropdown persisted under meta/profiles/{userid}/data/ with timestamped backups before each overwrite.
